name: Cardiovascular System
description: The cardiovascular system consists of the heart, blood vessels, and blood. It transports oxygen, nutrients, and hormones to tissues and removes waste products.

structures.name: Right Atrium
structures.function: Receives deoxygenated blood from the body

structures.name: Left Atrium
structures.function: Receives oxygenated blood from the lungs

structures.name: Left Ventricle
structures.function: Pumps blood to the entire body

structures.name: Aorta
structures.function: Largest artery, distributes blood to the body

structures.name: Left Coronary Artery
structures.function: Supplies blood to left heart muscle

structures.name: Right Coronary Artery
structures.function: Supplies blood to right heart muscle
